description: Published figures quoted beside Titra's results. They come from other patients and simulators, so they are context, not a head-to-head comparison.

trial.source: Subhi R et al. Automated oxygen control for preterm infants receiving continuous positive airway pressure in southwest Nigeria: an open-label, randomised, crossover trial. Lancet Glob Health 2025. doi:10.1016/S2214-109X(24)00458-3
trial.target: SpO2 91-95% on oxygen, 91-100% in room air

bench.source: Salverda HH et al. Neonatal automated oxygen titration algorithms: response characteristics and performance. Arch Dis Child Fetal Neonatal Ed 2026. doi:10.1136/archdischild-2026-330785

signal_loss.source: Langanky et al. Pulse oximetry signal loss during hypoxic episodes in preterm infants receiving automated oxygen control. Eur J Pediatr 2024. PMC11192802
signal_loss.finding: Signal loss is common during prolonged hypoxaemic episodes; a backup FiO2 applied during signal loss may prolong them.
